text:
maya: heads up onboarding Heliotrope-15B (Qwen-attn graft + Llama FF). conversion + hybrid int6 attempt completed. short tests fine, but docchain-summarize-6k blows up after ~1.2k tokens.
liam: int6? did we try int4/int8 baseline?
maya: we experimented with mixed int6 for most layers + int4 on head-heavy layers to save mem. int6 was a try to keep dynamic range for small rotary freq groups.
jorge: what does "blow up" look like? numbers?
maya: rouge-L -18 vs fp16 on the 6k doc set; ppl spikes starting at token ~1250. short context (<512) is fine.
nora: any converter warnings?
maya: log snippet: 
```
WARN: inferred_head_stride=2 (interleaved)
WARN: missing_metadata: rotary_groups not found
WARN: rotation_index_map: non-monotonic indices at layer 11
INFO: quantlib: applied hybrid_int6 (layers 0-6 int6, 7-9 int4, 10-14 int6)
```
liam: rotation_index_map non-monotonic + interleaved heads -> likely head permutation + rotary mapping mismatch. int6 quirks could hide the issue in short runs but amplify in long context.
jorge: did we dump per-head cosine fp16->quant for q/k/v projections?
maya: yes. Layers 10-12 mean cosine ~0.76, layers 0-6 ~0.98.
nora: layer 11 non-monotonic indices suspicious. Could be per-head phase offsets were present in source (e.g., phase_offsets: [0,0.25,0.75]) and got dropped. If a group expects fractional phase shift we must preserve that.
sam: also check tokenizer normalizer. Heliotrope's training used NFKC + ZWJ preservation; the converter defaulted to standard normalizer which strips some ZWJ sequences found in long pasted docs, shifting positions.
liam: can you show kv_phase_skew plots? if phase mismatch, skew should grow with position.
maya: brief kv_phase_skew excerpt: 
```
kv_phase_skew_layer11: t0=0.002 t512=0.087 t1024=0.312 t1536=0.684
kv_phase_skew_layer3: t0=0.001 t512=0.003 t1024=0.005 t1536=0.006
```
jorge: layer11 skew grows rapidly 70% by 1.5k tokens. That's a rotary/phase mismatch not pure quant.
nora: steps: 1) patch converter to read rotary_groups/phase_offsets/rotation_index_map when present and export an explicit per-layer rotary spec 2) canonicalize head ordering when inferred_head_stride!=1 and emit a permutation map artifact (and checksum) 3) retire hybrid int6 as default instead try per-channel symmetric int4 for q/k/v/out on suspect layers, or keep int6 but calibrate per-head scales 4) add tokenization preflight to run long-doc sample and assert token alignment <0.05% drift 5) add kv_phase_skew check in onboarding CI (fail if any layer >0.15 at t=512)
liam: agree. Also test an intermediate: re-export with per-layer phase_offsets restored (guess from model card notes) and permute heads to canonical order, then rerun quant lib with per-head calibration.
maya: did a quick local: forced phase_offsets for layer11=0.25, applied permutation -> re-quant int6 with per-head calibrator on layer11 q/k/v -> rouge-L improved +11 pts (now -7 vs fp16).
ora: good. Remaining gap likely quant granularity. Try per-channel int4 on layer11 and micro-bucket calibration for extreme tails.
jorge: also add a runtime validation: when loading model, compare stored permutation checksum with computed checksum; if mismatch, fail load and flag human triage.
sam: for tokenizer: implement upstream normalizer path during conversion or bundle a tokenizer.json that runtime can load.
ciabot: maya pushed branch "heliotrope/rotary-phase-perm-int6calib" with 3 commits. CI queued.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary to eng-dedicated at 2026-06-01T08:00:00Z routing 6% traffic to model:heliotrope-15b:v2-canary. automatic rollback if long-doc rouge-L drop >5 pts for 20m.
liam: I'll help with per-head calibration sweep tomorrow.
maya: thanks 5 will post CI logs and kv_phase_skew plots once CI finishes.
